topic: student-led anti-Meloni protest wave: education cuts, dilapidated schools, cost of living, the 30% limit on foreign pupils in classrooms, and Italian complicity in the Gaza war ("No Meloni Day")
scale: nationwide day-long school strike; 2,000+ students in Florence from 15+ high schools, demonstrations also in Rome, Milan, Turin, Genoa, Cagliari
quote1: Students from at least 15 high schools rally against education cuts and restrictions on foreign pupils, as nationwide demonstrations coincide with a children’s climate strike in Florence.
